short_description: Line Clipper: Tennis Tactics is a turn-based strategic tennis game. Zero in on your opponent’s pattern of play to gain the upper hand. Line up the perfect shot and simulate the outcome before committing to your next play. Sometimes the court is wide open, and sometimes you have to aim for the lines.
